summary: Named first-pass student corruption is repaired, but figure-role false positives, overbroad formula filtering and standalone-context gaps remain. Merge lesson 1-2 selectively to preserve assets and metadata.
report:
BLOCKER
- NEW regression ? 1-3, Teacher Edition RtISupport, anchor Example 4: NOT RESOLVED. Its prompt asks twice about ?the graph provided? but now contains no graph. The required blue V (vertex (8,0)) is classified answer:graph solely because its description says ?source answer identifies f(x)=|x-8|?. Preserve the question graph and move that answer annotation to notes. Ingest ANSWER_FIGURE_RE matches any occurrence of answer/solution, including negation and interface labels.
- Same classifier regression ? 1-2 Additional Example 4 (PurposefulQuestions, anchor Example 4): required original f polyline (-6,2),(-5,0),(-2,4),(0,5) disappears because the description says ?SOLUTION button ... no worked solution displayed?. The fresh 1-2 Lesson Quiz row also loses the entire Quiz 3 figure, including the GIVEN black f polyline, because it shares a figure with a magenta answer g. Split mixed question/answer layers; marking the whole figure question would expose the solution. These block a wholesale 1-2 replacement.

FIX
- NEW formula-filter regression ? 2-3, Savvas Example 4: ?Find the Zeros of a Quadratic Function? triggers ASKS_FOR_FORMULA_RE, although the task asks when a golf ball hits the ground, not for its model. The figure's given h(x)=-16x^2+16x+32 is removed, leaving ?Yellow ball in air with callout.? The model survives only indirectly in worked solution steps and notes. Narrow the trigger to the requested quantity and apply it per question/figure, not across an entire block/title. Another false trigger: 2-3 Try It 2, ?Identify the zeros of the function?; its equation is redundantly available in prose, so that row remains solvable. Do not filter teacher-reference givens as answer leaks.
- NEW false figure removals ? GeneralizeETP/Assess digital-resource rows: 1-4 loses a blank grid described as ?No solution lines or points drawn?; 2-1, 2-2, 2-3, 2-4, 2-5 lose question screenshots mentioning the ?Check Answer? button. Their descriptions survive in notes, but question figures/visual flags are wrong. Use explicit roles or contextual classification, not an anywhere-in-description word match.
- Prior standalone-context FIX: NOT RESOLVED. 1-3 Try It 1 still asks Alani's pay for 37/43 hours without $12/hour through 40 hours and $18/hour thereafter. 2-6 Try It 4 still refers to Rachel's serve without its model. Tags identify an example number, but no explicit context link or inherited givens makes either prompt self-contained. Supply context or enforce linked-example delivery before standalone use.

PRIOR FINDINGS RECHECK (severity of original finding retained below)
- BLOCKER, missing inputs: RESOLVED for all five named rows. 1-3 Try It 3(b) now includes its three graph segments; 1-4 q17 includes day 1 = 2 mi/day 5 = 3.2 mi; 2-3 q42 includes 9 m by 14 m. 1-4 q26/q35 also retain their question illustrations.
- BLOCKER, six leaking answer figures: RESOLVED for 1-3/2-1/2-7 launches, 1-3 Try It 5, 2-1 q21, 2-7 Try It 4. Answer figures are absent from prompts and retained as answer:* notes. The 1-3 Try It 5 explicit role override works. This does not excuse the new over-removal cases above.
- BLOCKER, truncated keys: RESOLVED across all nine lessons. Checked all 326 student blocks: every converted answer block appears in the matching row's notes; all 34 multipart rows retain their 64 formerly discarded subsequent answers. 1-4 q35 now includes recursive rule, 63 and 648; 2-6 q37 is Yes | No | No | Yes | No. Repeated values survive.
- BLOCKER, piecewise definitions: RESOLVED for the prior 41 affected source rows (28 in 1-3, 13 in 1-4). Cases are converted before row separators are stripped; expression/condition pairs now have semicolon boundaries. 1-3 q13 no longer merges x>3 with 5x-3; Try It 3 keys retain all three branches per part. In-memory cases-inside-tabular probe also preserves inner cases and outer table rows.
- BLOCKER, collapsed tables: RESOLVED for the prior row-boundary issue. simplify_tabular now runs before generic line-break removal. 2-1 q36 has six transformation rows and blank response cells; 2-4 q48 has seven unanswered rows after its three examples; 2-6 q37 has five equation rows with two blanks each; 1-4 q36 preserves the blank leading header cell. Empty cells become ___.
- BLOCKER, equations leaked in descriptions: RESOLVED for 2-1 q13/q29 and 2-3 q12: requested equations are absent from IMAGE prompts, retained in notes; vertices/intercepts remain. The generalized filter introduces the false-trigger regression above.
- FIX, math conversion: RESOLVED for the reported corpus issues. No residual \frac in any of the nine skeletons' prompts/notes; 1-4 q24/q30 and 2-6 radical fractions convert. No cdots-to-dot-plus-s corruption remains. Probes pass for nested braced radicals/fractions, \frac18, \frac n2, and complete-command substitutions. Requiring a nonletter after a control word is appropriate TeX tokenization; no damaged valid command from that boundary change was found.
- FIX, placeholders/visual metadata: RESOLVED for the prior raw-placeholder and false graph-flag cases: no raw \placeholder or IMAGE-with-has_visual=false remains in the nine skeletons. Nested descriptions enter notes; 2-7 q24/q29 retain question visuals. New misclassification can still remove the question image before this consistency check.
- FIX, calibration exception: RESOLVED. 2-5 calibration example_5.dok1 includes 52, as does example_3.dok1. All 268 practice declarations have exactly one matching row and matching inline DOK; all nine Lesson Quiz DOK and skills maps match independent TeX-table extraction.
- FIX, transcription comments: RESOLVED for the prior % FIG leakage; no such comments remain in prompts/notes. Figure descriptions remain in notes, but stripped coordinate comments themselves are not separately archived in rows (the TeX retains provenance).

NOTE
- Lesson 1-2: use a selective content/metadata merge after the above fixes, not wholesale replacement. There are 77 existing rows and 81 regenerated rows; source strings are not unique among TE addenda, and one ConceptSummary source changes kind. Preserve existing IDs, created_at and registry-managed metadata; do not regenerate suffix-based IDs by row order.
- Existing 1-2 image assets would be lost on these eight replacements (fresh image=null): 1-2-savvas-q14, 1-2-savvas-q15, 1-2-savvas-q28, 1-2-savvas-q33, 1-2-savvas-q34, 1-2-savvas-q35, 1-2-savvas-q38, 1-2-savvas-teacher-edition-generalizeetp-les-12. Preserve their image paths and reviewed visual metadata. The last row also has manual quiz DOK/key/crop-provenance notes absent from fresh notes, and its Quiz 3 given graph is newly removed.
- Additional 1-2 information losses to preserve/reconcile: 1-2-savvas-teacher-edition-learntogether-les loses its Mathematics Overview and Applying Math Practices paragraphs; 1-2-savvas-example-1-lesson-1-2 and 1-2-savvas-example-2-lesson-1-2 lose explicit graphical callout wording (differences of coordinates, reflected intercepts/slopes). Much related math survives elsewhere, but the callout annotations do not. 1-2-savvas-teacher-edition-generalizeetp-les-9 has no exact source match: its question/key survive under PurposefulQuestions/ConceptSummary, so remap it rather than discard it. Lesser resource/provenance wording also disappears from learntogether-les-2, learntogether-les-3, generalizeetp-les-9, generalizeetp-les-10 and rtisupport-lesson-2 (all with prefix 1-2-savvas-teacher-edition-). These are not new mathematical blockers.
- 1-2 Try It 4 remains dependent on Example 4's original graph; neither old nor fresh prompt includes it. This is an existing context gap, not a new loss. The new Additional Example 4 question figure is a separate classifier failure noted above.
- Parser limitations found by synthetic probes, not observed new corpus blockers: _arg skips spaces but not newlines, so a valid newline immediately after \frac produces a malformed fraction. Escaped \& is restored before table splitting, so a literal ampersand becomes an extra column. Preserve escaped characters through structural parsing and skip all TeX whitespace. brackets_to_parens also changes mathematical interval brackets in descriptions; preserve closed/open interval semantics when escaping IMAGE delimiters (e.g. 1-2 Example 1B says ?on (-2,2)? beside filled endpoints).
- Verification: all 713 saved skeleton rows exactly match read-only in-memory extraction from their nine TE files; all nine saved item-analysis maps match extraction, including the corrected duplicate association. Three built-in brace selftests pass; targeted math/table probes ran without writing files. No repository-wide suite or append was run. No git command was run, so this reviews the current changed implementations against the first report, not a retrieved historical git diff. GitNexus MCP was unavailable; no symbols were edited. Only this requested result JSON was written.
